_about: Reviewed LEAST/GREATEST calls over a possibly-NULL expression (DuckDB skips NULL arguments, so the bound is returned instead of NULL). Read by transform/tasks/coefficients/tests/test_sql_least_greatest_nullable.py. verdict: not_null = the argument cannot be NULL there (reason says why); intended = the NULL-skip cannot reach an output; open = a NULL would become the bound -- reported, not fixed. Counts are from the 2026-09-24 dev build. Edit a call and its entry goes stale on purpose.

entries.reason: compound_cliff_severity is not_null-tested on the compound_cliff_params seed and every (season, compound) group has at least one row, so the MEDIAN is never NULL.

entries.call: GREATEST(SQRT( GREATEST(syy - b_age_raw * sxy - b_hinge_raw * szy, 0) / GREATEST(n_laps_cliff - n_stints_cliff - 2, 1) * (sxx / NULLIF(det, 0)) ), 0.0001)
entries.reason: NULL only when det = 0 (collinear age/hinge). b_hinge_se is read only on cliff_qualifies rows (cliff_tau, cliff_field_mean and hinge_dev_shrunk filter on it), and cliff_qualifies requires det > 0, so the 1e-4 floor on a NULL is never consumed.

entries.call: GREATEST(SQRT( GREATEST(syy - slope_raw * sxy, 0) / GREATEST(n_laps - n_stints - 1, 1) / NULLIF(sxx, 0) ), 0.0001)
entries.reason: The SQRT is NULL only when sxx = 0 (a cell of single-lap stints), and every read of slope_se is gated on qualifies, which requires sxx > 0: field_mean and tau filter WHERE qualifies (centered's w is read only in tau), and the final SELECT's four reads sit behind WHEN c.qualifies or after WHEN NOT c.qualifies. qualifies is never NULL, because clean_laps drops NULL age and residual. So the 1e-4 floor on a NULL is never consumed; it exists for a near-perfect fit. Re-measured on the 2026-09-25 dev build (WI-13): 233 cells, 231 qualifying, 0 with sxx = 0, 0 qualifying with a NULL pre-floor SE, 0 at the floor. (Was 'open' on the claim that the final SELECT reads slope_se for every cell, which the code does not.)
n_laps and n_stints are COUNT aggregates of the same GROUP BY row and cannot be NULL.
COUNT aggregates of the same GROUP BY row; never NULL.
b_age_raw / b_hinge_raw are NULL only when det <= 0 (det is a Gram determinant, so only det = 0), where the enclosing sxx / NULLIF(det, 0) is NULL anyway; the floor absorbs a slightly negative RSS.
slope_raw is NULL only when sxx = 0, and then the enclosing division by NULLIF(sxx, 0) is NULL whatever this returns; the floor exists to absorb a slightly negative RSS from float rounding.

Same two columns as the upper bound beside it: 0 NULL raw_affinity_s of 1,034; global_driver_mean_s from an INNER JOIN over the same residuals.

p is a dim_compounds_season row (compound_cliff_onset_laps is not_null-tested on the seed) and a.age_laps is a generated series, so neither side is NULL. Passed as the laps_past_cliff argument of compound_cliff_wear_s, which is itself NULL-guarded.

The CASE NULL-tests actual_pit_lap and optimal_total_cost_race_s but not actual_total_cost_race_s; a NULL there would read as a 0.0 opportunity cost. Does not fire: 0 of the 5,112 stints graded with a stop on the 2026-09-25 dev build (after WI-13's F31 fix). Left open as a judgement call, not a one-liner: the CASE already maps an ungradeable stint (no stop, no optimum) to 0.0, so NULL-preserving here would add a third convention for 'cannot grade', and the choice between 0.0 and NULL reaches fct_stint_features.tyre_management_score and the app's cost totals.

The CASE NULL-tests actual_pit_lap and pick_optimal_cost_s but not pick_actual_cost_s; a NULL there would read as a 0.0 opportunity cost. Does not fire: 0 of the 5,112 stints graded with a stop on the 2026-09-25 dev build (after WI-13's F31 fix). Left open for the same judgement call as the race-horizon clip beside it: 0.0 vs NULL for a stint the model cannot grade.
